search_text: published ZDI-24-1697 ZDI-CAN-23994 XWiki.org XWiki SolrSearchMacros text Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-12-19 CVE-2025-24893 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-24893 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['XWiki.org'] ['XWiki'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of XWiki.org XWiki. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the text parameter provided to the SolrSearchMacros endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. title: XWiki.org XWiki SolrSearchMacros text Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of XWiki.org XWiki. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the text parameter provided to the SolrSearchMacros endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
